section: Figure 8. First-line management of mTNBC.
text:
Figure 8. First-line management of mTNBC.

Figure 8. First-line management of mTNBC. (algorithm path): Previously untreated mTNBC^a → PD-L1+ → Pembrolizumab-sacituzumab govitecan^c,d [I, A]; Pembrolizumab-ChT^c,e [I, A; MCBS 4]^f; Atezolizumab-nab-paclitaxel^g,h [II, A; MCBS 3]^f → [PD] → Second-line treatment (see Figure 9) Footnotes: a: De novo or recurrence >6 months after the end of (neo)adjuvant ICI therapy. c: When PD-L1 CPS ≥10 and DFI ≥6 months after adjuvant treatment, noting that limited data are available after neo(adjuvant) ICI therapy. d: FDA approved, not EMA approved. e: ChT is physician’s choice of paclitaxel, nab-paclitaxel or carboplatin—gemcitabine. g: When immune cell PD-L1 positivity ≥1% and DFI ≥12 months after adjuvant treatment. h: EMA approved, not FDA approved.

Figure 8. First-line management of mTNBC. (algorithm path): Previously untreated mTNBC^a → PD-L1- → gBRCA wt → Dato-DXd^j,k [I, A; MCBS 4]^f; Sacituzumab govitecan^j,k [I, A; MCBS 2]^f; Taxane monotherapy [I, A]; Anthracycline monotherapy^l [I, A]; Capecitabine^m [I, B]; Capecitabine-bevacizumab^h,m [I, B; MCBS 3]^f; Taxane^m [I, B]; Taxane-bevacizumab^h,m [I, B; MCBS 2]^f → [PD] → Second-line treatment (see Figure 9) Footnotes: a: De novo or recurrence >6 months after the end of (neo)adjuvant ICI therapy. h: EMA approved, not FDA approved. j: EMA CHMP positive opinion, FDA approved. k: Recommended if available. Dato-DXd is the preferred option for patients relapsing within 6 months of adjuvant therapy [I, A]. l: If no prior exposure or if rechallenge is possible. m: Preferred in case of imminent organ failure.
